questions.text: Activation rate on mobile: what percentage of mobile visits got into the app? A visit got in if it has a choice (selection) whose value is "discover". Photo app only, no test runs. (One decimal)
The same for desktop: what percentage of desktop visits got into the app? (One decimal)
How many visits came from Instagram? Some Instagram links were tagged "ig" instead of "instagram": count those as Instagram too.
Among Instagram visits (including "ig"), what percentage of the mobile ones got into the app? (One decimal)
Among Instagram visits, what percentage of the desktop ones got into the app? (One decimal)
How many photo visits (no test runs) have no platform recorded?

Make segments from source and platform (count "ig" as Instagram; no source = "direct"; skip visits with no platform). Among segments with at least 30 visits, which one has the highest activation rate? Answer as "source platform", for example "whatsapp mobile".
A visit is "returning" if the same browser had visited the photo app before (in time order). What percentage of returning visits got into the app? (One decimal)
